rejections.reason: This is Victron Energy's Ekrano, Venus and Cerbo GX manual hosted by Volthium; the Cerbo GX is Victron's product, not Volthium's.

rejections.name: Operation voltage range
rejections.reason: The "With communication" range; the same row prints another range "Without communication".

rejections.name: Storage environment
rejections.reason: One of two storage rows, by storage time; the name alone does not say which.

rejections.name: AC Input
rejections.reason: The specification table has JP, US and EU/AU/ZA columns, and the manual does not say which the product is; the value is one column's.

rejections.name: AC Output
rejections.reason: The specification table has JP, US and EU/AU/ZA columns, and the manual does not say which the product is; the value is one column's.

rejections.name: DC Output
rejections.reason: The DC5521 input row, not a DC output: "12V/10A,24V/10A (MaX 240W)".

rejections.name: Peak Power
rejections.reason: The specification table has JP, US and EU/AU/ZA columns, and the manual does not say which the product is; the value is one column's.

rejections.name: Short circuit protection time
rejections.reason: The technical sheet answers "Short circuit protection" with "Yes" and prints 300 min as the capacity at 20 A; it gives no short-circuit protection time.

rejections.name: Discharge current
rejections.reason: The manual says the 5 kWh batteries push a current parameter of 100 AMP for discharge over the communication link, and that the parameters the battery pushes are conservative, so it is a communicated setting rather than the battery's rated discharge current.
